notSaved: Not saved: this change conflicts with another part of your plan.
changed: Your plan changed in another browser tab, so this change was not saved. The form now shows the saved plan; make your change again.

country.label: Country
country.notLoaded: The country profiles are not loaded on this device.

data.heading: Your data
data.exportLine: Exports are generated by {product} from your own entries; not advice. Check figures before any tax or financial use.
data.exportNotSaved: The file was not saved. Export again to keep a copy.
data.exportDateFailed: The backup file was saved, but this device could not record the export date. Export again to record it.
data.exportLeftOut: Exports leave out {figure} {count, plural, one {entry} other {entries}} saved by a newer version of {product}. Reload the page, then export to include {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
data.noPlan: Nothing to export yet. Set up a plan or import a file.

taxYear.label: Tax year
taxYear.noEntries: No entries yet, so there is no tax year to export.
taxYear.notLoaded: Your country's rules are not loaded on this device. Reload the page when you are online to export a tax year.

file.title: {product} tax-year file · {country} · {from} to {to}
file.owned: Data from your log. Not a tax computation.
file.currency: Amounts are as you logged them and are not converted. Your pay currency is {currency}.
file.notConverted: Amounts are as you logged them and are not converted to {countryCurrency}. Your pay currency is {currency}.
file.reviewed: {country} rules reviewed on {date} · general information, not advice
file.reviewedSources: {country} rules reviewed on {date} · general information, not advice · Sources: {sources}
file.generic: Reviewed on {date}: the general profile, not a rule for your country · general information, not advice
file.underReview: {country} rules not reviewed since {date} · general information, not advice
file.matched: Each sale is matched to purchases of the same coin, {rule, select, lifo {last in, first out} other {first in, first out}}.
file.raw: Sales are not matched to purchases in this file. The pooling or matching is for your accountant.
file.holding: eligible_from: the first day past the {country} holding rule ({unit, select, years {{count, plural, one {{figure} year} other {{figure} years}}} other {{count, plural, one {{figure} day} other {{figure} days}}}}). past_holding_rule: whether that day had come by the sale, or by {held} for units still held. Computed from your dates, not tax advice.
file.holdingRaw: eligible_from: the first day past the {country} holding rule ({unit, select, years {{count, plural, one {{figure} year} other {{figure} years}}} other {{count, plural, one {{figure} day} other {{figure} days}}}}). Computed from your dates, not tax advice.
file.planRule: Your plan uses its own holding rule. This file uses the {country} rule.
file.perVenue: Sales are matched per venue as named in the Log. Entries with no venue are one group.
file.crossVenue: In {count, plural, one {{figure} row} other {{figure} rows}}, the sale took units bought at another venue. sale_venue shows where those sales were made.
file.heldAt: held_at: where the units were when sold, paid as a network fee, or at the year end, empty for no venue and on rows with no acquired date. moved_on: the date a Coins moved entry took them there, empty if none did.
file.moveFee: A row with disposed_on but no proceeds holds the units a Coins moved entry paid as its network fee, and leaves past_holding_rule empty. This file does not say whether your country treats that fee as a disposal.
file.feeAtDestination: {count, plural, one {In {figure} row, the Log took a Coins moved entry's network fee from units already at the venue the coins went to. On that date the Log shows too few units outside that venue for what the entry sent. Check that Coins moved entry in the Log.} other {In {figure} rows, the Log took a Coins moved entry's network fee from units already at the venue the coins went to. On each row's disposed_on date the Log shows too few units outside its held_at venue for what its Coins moved entry sent. Check the Coins moved entry of each of those rows in the Log.}}
file.moveRows: A move row lists units sent from venue to to_venue. units_received is what arrived. units less units_received is the network fee, paid in the coin.
file.moveFeeRaw: This file does not say whether your country treats that fee as a disposal.
file.pooledListed: For a coin sold, or paid as a network fee, in the tax year, every entry to {to} is listed for the pool. Its purchases to {windowEnd} are listed for the 30-day rule.
file.rawListed: For a coin sold, or paid as a network fee, in the tax year, every entry to {to} is listed.
file.windowOpen: Made on {today}: purchases after that day are not in this file.
file.format: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts and units use a decimal point.
file.uncosted: On a held row, an empty cost_basis means no cost was recorded, not a cost of zero. Rows with no acquired date leave cost_basis empty.
file.uncostedRaw: On a held row, an empty cost_basis means no cost was recorded, not a cost of zero. Sale rows leave cost_basis empty.
file.estimated: units_estimated yes: {product}'s Bought as planned button filled in the units from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee or venue it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.
file.estimatedBlock: units_estimated yes: the sale or a holding row in its block counts units that {product}'s Bought as planned button filled in from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee or venue it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.
file.unmatched: A row with no acquired date holds units sold, or paid as a network fee, that no logged purchase covered.
file.ongoing: The tax year ends on {to}. This file shows your log as of {today}.
file.cessions: Each block is one sale from your log: a holding row for each coin held just before it, then the sale row. Purchases have no rows here: the CSV log lists every entry. The calculation from these figures is left to you or your accountant.
file.cessionPrices: On holding rows, the coin sold is valued at its own sale price. The other coins carry no market price in this file. estimated_portfolio_value is filled only when the coin sold was the only coin held and your log holds the units sold.
file.cessionCosts: purchase_costs_to_date sums the amounts of the purchases and the recorded costs of the Coins added entries logged before each sale, and purchase_fees_to_date their fees. Neither is reduced by earlier sales. Amounts are as you logged them, whether or not they include a fee.
file.heldWithoutCost: held_without_cost_to_date: how many Coins added entries before the sale have no recorded cost. purchase_costs_to_date leaves them out.
file.snapshotReference: units_on_{opening} is your log at the start of {reference}, which is the end of {eve}. {ongoing, select, yes {units_on_{closing} stays empty until the year has ended.} other {units_on_{closing} is your log at the end of {to}.}}
file.snapshotValues: This file holds units and logged amounts but no market prices, so the value_on_{opening} and value_on_{closing} cells are empty, except 0.00 where you held none.
file.heldInYear: held_units counts the units of Coins added entries dated in this year. If you had those coins before {reference}, units_on_{opening} leaves them out.
file.feeUnits: fee_units: units the year's Coins moved entries paid as network fees, in the coin.
file.heldCost: An empty held_cost means a Coins added entry has no recorded cost, not a cost of zero.
file.estimatedUnits: Some units come from {product}'s Bought as planned button, filled in from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.

import.heading: Import a file
import.file: {name}, exported on {date}. Entries in this backup: {count}.
import.pasted: Pasted backup, exported on {date}. Entries in this backup: {count}.
import.result: Entries added: {added}. Already in this plan, not added: {skipped}.
import.deletedHere: Deleted earlier on this device, not added: {deleted}.
import.taken: Month already recorded or skipped on this device, not added: {taken}.
import.currencyMismatch: The purchases in this file are in {file}, and this plan's are in {plan}, so nothing was added. Amounts are never converted. If you want the file's plan and its currency in place of this one, choose the file again, then Replace everything.
import.currencyMismatchPasted: The purchases in the pasted text are in {file}, and this plan's are in {plan}, so nothing was added. Amounts are never converted. If you want the pasted plan and its currency in place of this one, paste the text again, then Replace everything.
import.tooManyEntries: Adding these entries would leave {entries} entries in this plan, more than the {max} a plan holds, so nothing was added. Delete entries in the Log, then import again. To keep only the file's entries, import again with Replace everything.
import.tooManyInFile: This export from the DCA plan page holds {file} purchases, more than the {max} entries a plan holds, so nothing was imported. Delete purchases there, export again, then import the new file.
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB, larger than any backup of a plan, so it was not read. Choose a backup from {product} or an export from the DCA plan page.
import.newerRows: A newer version of {product} saved or deleted entries on this device, so nothing was imported. Reload the page, then import again.
import.invalidEntries: {count, plural, one {{figure} entry} other {{figure} entries}} in this import cannot be stored, so nothing was imported. Export a new backup from {product} on the device that made it, then import the new file.
import.invalidEntriesPasted: {count, plural, one {{figure} entry} other {{figure} entries}} in the pasted text cannot be stored, so nothing was imported. Export a new backup from {product} on the device that made it, then paste the new text.

paste.label: Paste a backup or an export from the DCA plan page

prototype.file: {name}, exported from the DCA plan page. Purchases in this file: {count}.
prototype.pasted: Pasted text, exported from the DCA plan page. Purchases in this text: {count}.
prototype.country: Files from the DCA plan page have no country. Choose the country you live in; the plan keeps the file's holding rule and currencies, which you can change in Hold & sell and Currency & data.
prototype.confirmBody: The plan and purchases in this file take their place, with the file's holding rule; export a copy first if you want to keep this plan.

report.coins-defaulted: The file listed no coins, so the plan has the DCA plan page's four starting coins: Bitcoin, Chainlink, Ethereum, and Solana. You can change them in Coins & split.
report.coin-added: {coin} had purchases but was not in the file's list of coins, so it was added to the plan.
report.coin-not-in-plan: {count, plural, one {{figure} purchase of {coin} was} other {{figure} purchases of {coin} were}} added. This plan does not list {coin}, so Portfolio shows it after the plan's coins; you can add it in Coins & split.
report.split-from-dca-split: The split comes from the file's older monthly split.
report.split-normalised: The {coin} share changed from {from} to {to}, so the split adds up to 100 %.
report.currency-defaulted: {field, select, payCurrency {The currency you pay in} other {The currency shown}} was missing or unknown, so it is {field, select, payCurrency {EUR} other {USD}}.
report.starting-amount-from-steps: The starting amount is the sum of the file's lump-sum steps.
report.plan-amounts-rounded: The monthly and starting amounts were rounded to the cent.
report.first-buy-from-entries: The first buy is the date of the earliest purchase in the file.
report.last-buy-defaulted: The file had no last buy, so it is {date}, as on the DCA plan page.
report.buy-day-clamped: The file's buy day was outside 1 to 28, so the buy day is now {day}.
report.hold-days-defaulted: The file had no holding period, so the holding rule is 365 days.
report.sell-window-dropped: The file's sell window had a date missing, so the plan has no sell window. You can set one in Hold & sell.
report.sell-window-accepted-early: The sell window opens before the last buy has been held for the holding period; it stays as the file had it.
report.expectation-dropped: The {scenario, select, bear {low} base {middle} other {high}} multiple you set on the DCA plan page was not a number, so it was left out.
report.tax-note-dropped: The file's tax note was not imported. Copy it from the DCA plan page if you want to keep it.
report.entries-dropped: {count, plural, one {{figure} purchase was not imported: it was} other {{figure} purchases were not imported: they were}} missing a coin, an amount, units or a date.
report.entries-rounded: {count, plural, one {{figure} purchase was} other {{figure} purchases were}} rounded: amounts to the cent, units to 10 decimal places.
report.monthly-without-month: {count, plural, one {{figure} monthly buy had no month, so it is} other {{figure} monthly buys had no month, so they are}} logged as extra buys.
report.fees-dropped: {count, plural, one {{figure} fee was not an amount, so it was} other {{figure} fees were not amounts, so they were}} left out.
report.notes-shortened: {count, plural, one {{figure} note was} other {{figure} notes were}} cut to 500 characters.
report.ids-regenerated: {count, plural, one {{figure} purchase in this file had no usable reference, so importing this file again adds it} other {{figure} purchases in this file had no usable reference, so importing this file again adds them}} a second time.

confirm.title: Replace this plan and its {count, plural, one {{figure} entry} other {{figure} entries}}?
confirm.body: The backup's plan and entries take their place; export a copy first if you want to keep this plan.

delete.title: {count, plural, =0 {Delete this plan?} one {Delete this plan and its {figure} entry?} other {Delete this plan and its {figure} entries?}}
delete.body: {count, plural, =0 {Export a copy first if you want to keep it.} other {Export a copy first if you want to keep them.}}
delete.undoRefused: Another browser tab started or imported a plan after you deleted this one, so it stays deleted.

about.heading: About
about.line: Data and tools, not advice. Crypto-assets can lose all their value.

reminder.heading: Calendar reminder
reminder.line: One event on each buy day left in your plan. Add it if you chose Later, or again after you change the buy day. Your calendar may keep the earlier event; delete it there.
reminder.notSaved: The calendar file was not saved. Add it again.
reminder.noneLeft: No buy days left, so there is no reminder to add.
reminder.ended: Buying ended on {date}, so there is no reminder to add. If you added the calendar file, your calendar keeps its events after that day; delete them there.
reminder.paused: The buy days left are paused, so there is no reminder to add. After you resume the plan, you can add it here.
